Title: Automatic Telescopic Doors & Operators
Body HTML: Telescopic sliding systems are designed with the back leaves moving at half the speed of the front ones. This coordinated motion allows both sets of leaves to open fully at the same time, creating an opening up to 2/3 of the total width. With four movable leaves instead of two, these systems provide greater convenience in limited spaces.
